facts.text: By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Terminus had fallen under the sphere of influence of the Gorensla Hutt clan.

evidence.quote: By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Terminus had fallen under the sphere of influence of the Gorensla Hutt clan.

facts.text: In 0 ABY, Terminus became a hunting ground for a group of exiles from the Red Nebula, who kidnapped a number of smugglers and mercenaries to facilitate a heist of the Nebula's Great Life Jewels.

evidence.quote: In 0 ABY, Terminus became a hunting ground for a group of exiles from the Red Nebula, who kidnapped a number of smugglers and mercenaries to facilitate a heist of the Nebula's Great Life Jewels.

facts.text: In 4 ABY, the remaining Nagai survivors of their defeat at the hands of Alliance of Free Planets forces at the Second Battle of Endor traveled to Terminus, using it as a waypoint for their retreat up the Hydian Way and the Corellian Trade Spine.

evidence.quote: In 4 ABY, the remaining Nagai survivors of their defeat at the hands of Alliance of Free Planets forces at the Second Battle of Endor traveled to Terminus, using it as a waypoint for their retreat up the Hydian Way and the Corellian Trade Spine.

facts.text: The Alliance forces followed and clashed with the Nagai at Terminus, a battle in which the Nagai raiders prevailed.

evidence.quote: The Alliance forces followed and clashed with the Nagai at Terminus, a battle in which the Nagai raiders prevailed.

facts.text: Terminus' main spaceport featured a number of well-regarded cantinas and leisure establishments, especially down the side streets where tourists were less likely to look.

evidence.quote: Terminus' main spaceport featured a number of well-regarded cantinas and leisure establishments, especially down the side streets where tourists were less likely to look.

facts.text: Terminus first appeared in Star Wars 50: The Crimson Forever, written by Archie Goodwin and released in 1981.

evidence.quote: Terminus first appeared in Star Wars 50: The Crimson Forever, written by Archie Goodwin and released in 1981.

facts.text: In its comic appearance, the world was illustrated by Al Williamson.

facts.text: Terminus shares a name with a planet that was mentioned in George Lucas' third story draft of Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, but was ultimately removed from the final film.
